## Scope check

Assisted mode is the premise of the project, not a setting:
**nothing submits a LinkedIn application without an explicit, separate, user-confirmed action.**
Requests that reduce human oversight — auto-apply, unattended or overnight runs, bulk submit,
skipping a security challenge, storing a LinkedIn password — are out of scope and will be closed.
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#the-two-rules).

- [ ] This does not reduce the human review step before submission
- [ ] This does not require storing LinkedIn credentials
- [ ] This does not involve bypassing a CAPTCHA or security verification
